hypothesis.observed_bottleneck: Every post-promotion trial preserved the champion's macro assumption that causal control improves when representation work and strength work are separated by a complete-engine handoff. The bounded realizations were individually coherent and publicly valid but did not generalize: frontier-scoped null-move work changed sign across anchors; precommitted root-ordering and aspiration work lost both completed pairs; cross-ply transposition-table mate-score correction improved semantics but lost both pairs; and adaptive principal-variation probing also lost both pairs. These outcomes do not condemn those engine mechanisms or authorize tuning them. Together they suggest that rewriting and serializing the whole engine between specialized calls can discard the live causal context needed to distinguish a useful edit from a coherent but weak one.

causal_change.factor: Continuity of causal-state ownership across diagnosis, implementation, and executable feedback
causal_change.before: Distinct calls own representation normalization and strength construction, so the complete engine artifact is the only high-bandwidth state that crosses the role boundary and each later call must reconstruct causal intent from serialized code and bounded text.
causal_change.after: One persistent engine-producing actor owns a single mutable anchor-derived work lineage for the entire diagnosis, one coherent implementation, task-general executable intervention, and evidence-led repair cycle, retaining its causal model until it emits the sole final engine.
causal_change.why_causal: Ownership continuity determines whether source observations, intended mechanism, edit rationale, surprising probe results, and repair decisions remain jointly available at the moment of final construction or are repeatedly reconstructed across artifact handoffs. Collapsing the workflow to one persistent actor and removing intermediate complete-engine emissions are necessary consequences of this one factor, not additional causal changes.

hypothesis.expected_effect: An uninterrupted actor should preserve anchor-specific implementation knowledge while directly connecting one causal hypothesis to its edit and task-general executable consequences, reducing wholesale semantic rewrites and cross-call objective drift. The candidate predicts zero invalid arms, more pair wins than losses, and candidate-median Elo strictly above incumbent-median Elo; if it does not promote but retains at least the configured 0.90 score-rate ratio, only the bounded development cycle is warranted.
hypothesis.falsifier: Falsify formal promotion unless the applicable matched batch has all required valid pairs, candidate wins strictly exceeding losses, candidate-median Elo strictly exceeding incumbent-median Elo, and zero invalid arms. Under counter search, reject this alternative family rather than develop it when the exact three-pair ratio or decisive bounded assessment is below 0.90. Mechanistically falsify it if execution emits an intermediate complete engine for another role, loses causal ownership to a reviewer or selector, or creates multiple working candidates instead of repairing one unfinished lineage.
hypothesis.behavioral_novelty: The loop can retain one live causal model across source inspection, implementation, surprising executable evidence, and repair of the same unfinished engine. No champion-family call can do this end to end: its normalizer must emit before the strength owner begins, and every added local, probe, or reentry variation communicates through a role boundary.

family_break.champion_family: Executable Semantic-Normal-Form Transduction: a representation-only call emits a complete canonical engine, then a distinct strength call consumes that artifact, with optional downstream probe or reentry roles.
rejected_core_assumptions: A behavior-preserving semantic-normal-form engine must be emitted before a useful strength change can be constructed.
Splitting representation, diagnosis, and implementation ownership across model-call boundaries improves causal control more than preserving one actor's live causal state.
forbidden_champion_mechanisms: A complete behavior-preserving semantic-normal-form engine emitted as an intermediate artifact
Any complete-engine handoff from a representation owner to a separate strength owner
A downstream reviewer, verifier, probe synthesizer, selector, or semantic-reentry role that consumes a provisional engine
Parallel or repeated candidate-producing calls, samples, variants, or best-of-N selection under any renamed role
family_break.alternative_causal_principle: Causal coherence comes from uninterrupted experimental ownership of one mutable work lineage: the same actor observes the anchor, states one mechanism, implements it, executes task-general interventions, incorporates contradictory evidence by repairing that same unfinished source, and emits once. No complete engine is serialized between reasoning owners.

difference_from_champion.information_flow: The champion compresses representation work into a complete engine artifact and transfers ownership to another call. The alternative keeps code, causal rationale, live observations, and edit state inside one actor until final emission.
difference_from_champion.error_detection: The champion uses pass-local checks whose downstream owner must reinterpret without the first owner's live causal context. The alternative designs and executes checks against the same actor's active causal claim and observes their consequences before that context is discarded.
difference_from_champion.final_decision: The champion's final engine is the output of a later owner acting on an inherited artifact. The alternative has one evolved actor decide when its one working lineage has satisfied its causal and executable obligations and then emit once.
difference_from_champion.failure_recovery: The champion repairs within isolated passes or adds a later recovery role. The alternative treats a failed probe as new evidence inside the same unfinished construction state and revises that one source directly, without rollback arbitration, candidate switching, or a backward cross-call edge.

family_break.non_derivative_probe: Audit the construction trace on the same supplied anchor. The alternative is present only if exactly one model call owns one mutable source lineage from initial diagnosis through at least one task-general executable observation to the sole final emission, with no intermediate complete-engine response and no second role. Emitting a semantic-normal-form engine, handing any engine to another call, or comparing multiple working engines identifies the champion family or a forbidden derivative instead.

strengths: Eliminates complete-engine serialization and causal-intent reconstruction between specialized model calls.
Lets one actor relate unexpected executable evidence directly to the edit and source assumptions that produced it.
Preserves useful undocumented anchor behavior by working on one mutable lineage rather than globally canonicalizing it first.
Contains exactly one call and one final engine, with no replicated agents, candidates, samples, reviewers, or best-of-N selection.
risks: A single actor may anchor on its first diagnosis and lack independent criticism.
Without a normalization pass, implicit cross-component dependencies may remain hidden and make a coherent edit brittle.
Keeping diagnosis, implementation, and testing in one context may exhaust reasoning capacity before a meaningful strength change is complete.
In-place repair may preserve a flawed causal premise because no separate owner challenges it.
hypothesis.dominant_assumption: The champion assumes that causal coherence requires materializing a behavior-preserving semantic normal form and transferring the resulting complete engine to a distinct strength owner.
hypothesis.inversion: Causal coherence is higher when one persistent actor retains uninterrupted ownership of the original anchor, one working source, its causal hypothesis, executable evidence, and repair decisions, with no semantic-normal-form artifact or engine handoff before final emission.

structure.name: Persistent Single-Actor Causal Workshop
structure.information_flow: The task, one anchor engine, aggregate metrics, bounded capsule, candidate hypothesis, and loop contract enter one evolved persistent actor. Diagnosis, one coherent source transformation, task-general executable interventions, and repairs occur on one unfinished mutable lineage inside that call; exactly one complete engine leaves as the final artifact. This is an evolved causal-workshop candidate, not the external Direct calibration control.

calls.objective: Own exactly one supplied anchor and one mutable working source from start to finish. Inspect the bounded task evidence and source, state exactly one highest-leverage task-general causal weakness, implement one coherent algorithmic improvement without first rewriting the engine into a semantic normal form, and execute focused causal interventions plus legality, UCI, state-integrity, timing-safety, and tactical sanity checks. When evidence contradicts the active implementation, update the causal model and repair that same unfinished source in place; intermediate edits are construction states, never complete candidates to score, rank, preserve, or select. Emit exactly one complete production engine only after its bounded obligations hold. Do not create alternative engines, parallel agents, replicated samples, best-of-N selection, reviewer or verifier roles, rollback arbitration, benchmark-specific logic, or engine-hyperparameter tuning as the structural hypothesis. Do not reproduce the external Direct control: explicitly use the supplied capsule, candidate hypothesis, and loop contract to enforce this evolved persistent-experiment protocol.
